officialLinks.label: Grading, P/F, W, incompletes, repeats, GPA inclusion

helpIntro: UChicago College uses a 4.0 quality-grade scale. Enter transcript units and final grades to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For College undergraduates. P and W do not enter GPA; F counts as 0.0. External transfer grades are excluded. Repeat Impact is unavailable because both graded attempts count. Graduate and professional-school grading may differ.
helpExample: A 100-unit A earns 400 grade-point units and a 100-unit B earns 300. Together, 700 ÷ 200 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.F: F earns 0.0 grade points and remains GPA-bearing even though it does not confer credit.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass confers credit when permitted but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal does not confer credit and does not affect GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.NGR: No Grade is unresolved and excluded until a final grade is posted.

specialTypes.name: UChicago College course
specialTypes.note: Use the final quality grade and transcript units. P/W/I/NGR follow their listed treatment.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Grades from other institutions do not enter the College GPA.

specialTypes.name: Off-campus external course
specialTypes.note: External off-campus grades are excluded unless the course is listed with a University of Chicago course number.

specialTypes.name: Graduate/professional UChicago course
specialTypes.note: Courses numbered 30000+ and professional-school courses may follow different grading rules; confirm the posted College-record grade before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed row. Both grades count in GPA; the calculator does not decide repeat eligibility or degree-credit treatment.
